$schema: options schema - options are overridden by npm run config

options.name: CAMEL_ENABLE_PYTHON
options.description: Build python.cmo, pyplot.cmo, and py_bridge* (requires Python dev layout)

options.name: CAMEL_TENSOR_BLAS
options.description: Use a system CBLAS (find_package(BLAS)) for a matmul whose node the 7.3 rule lets run on the library GEMM (tensor.kernel="library", written by tensor::fuse); safe mode and every withheld node stay on the canonical builtin kernels. On by default: without a findable CBLAS the builtin GEMM is the library path and the build is unchanged
